notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.910 Released - Security Update
notes.content:
2025-09-19 - Released Version 1.1.1.910 - Security Update
[list]
[*]Updated the LibreHardwareMonitorLib dependency to remove use of the WinRing0 driver. According to CVE-2020-14979, the driver is vulnerable to privilege escalation attack, meaning that if a user were to download and run malicious software, that software could exploit a running instance of the WinRing0 driver as a method to gain administrator rights without asking the user through a User Account Control prompt.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.886 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Made adjustments to how window opacity and click through state are changed to hopefully make it more reliable in different environments.[/*][*]New options are now available for Click Through Overlay and Ghost Window functionality. By default, windows will become temporarily clickable while focused. Once you switch to a different application, click-through functionality will be restored. This allows you to easily make adjustments to your click through overlays without having to toggle them off and on manually. To focus on the unclickable window, you can use the task bar, task ring, task menu, or alt tab. Additionally, you can still select the old functionality of the window never being clickable or make it so that it loses its transparency while its clickable.[/*][*]Fixed some issues with window targeting where some invisible windows would become the target of actions. This primarily effected the drag click features of many tools, such as Borderless Fullscreen and Click Through Overlay, where you hold the orb button with the left mouse click and then right click on the desired window. This does not effect focused window targeting, which is when you simply press the orb button and it targets the currently focused window.[/*][*]Fixed a bug in Glass Apps that would cause it to perform unnecessary calculations when not enabled.[/*][*]Added a content font setting in the style menu. For now, this field will require manually entering the exact name of the font family desired.[/*][*]Added more color style options for orb buttons. Some of the color settings do not have live preview enabled, so you may need to open a new flyout window to see your changes.[/*][*]Adjusted the behavior of "Flyout Auto Remove Topmost" to activate when the majority of a newly focused window is covered by a Simplode flyout window so that it will not cover the newly focused window. I am still unsure what the best strategy for it should be, so feedback would be nice.[/*][*]Added the "Legacy" window flyout option. This will cause all Simplode flyout overlay windows to have their style overridden to that of a standard window with no animations or transparency, resulting in increased application efficiency and a more classic application appearance. The option itself is available under "Customize Style"->"Flyout Mode" and can also be triggered by the new "Legacy" performance preset in the "Welcome" screen.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Released Version 1.1.1.817
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a race condition issue that could cause Chill Boost to crash.[/*][*]Updated Chill Boost to improve support for newer processors.[/*][*]Changed Chill Boost Efficiency Locker Mode default to Performance. This should be a better default setting for people first trying Chill Boost, as it still improves efficiency of heavy background tasks without negatively impacting foreground performance most of the time. Users who desire greater energy efficiency should still try the Efficiency Optimized mode.[/*][*]Adjusted Efficiency Locker to be automatically deactivated when another user is in an interactive session. This effects when Simplode Suite is still running under one user but the interactive session is now operating under another user. In this case, thermal and load limits will remain active. If the other user's session has Chill Boost activated, it will take over power control. This fixes a problem where performance can be unintentionally reduced when switching to another user, but retains full efficiency benefits of the efficiency locker if your PC is in the lock screen.[/*][*]Fixed bug in error logging code which can cause the application to become unable to launch.[/*][*]Fixed bug that could state desynchronization between separate processes within the application.[/*][*]Removed some notifications regarding product registration for Steam users. These messages have been causing confusion, as it was not immediately clear that the registration was optional and left users wondering if their Steam purchase was properly recognized. Steam users should only need to register if they want the ability to reliably run Simplode Suite's tools while Steam is not running.[/*][*]Upgraded application to .NET Framework 4.8, which should result in minor performance and efficiency increases throughout the application. This change was required to update dependencies needed for modernizing Chill Boost.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Released Version 1.1.1.719
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Included a DPI fix for older operating system versions.[/*][*]Fixed an issue that could cause the tool to become unresponsive after a rendering failure.[/*][*]Fixed an issue when using the tool to launch other programs, they would not have a working directory causing some programs to fail.[/*][*]Made improvements to window detection to make it more reliable and up to date, helping the tiling window manager and other features that target application windows to work more reliably.[/*][*]Added "(Language)" to the label for the language selector, in case you change the language and can no longer find the language option.[/*][*]Added a webcam settings editor utility in beta.[/*][*]Fixed issue when uninstalling the Steam edition of the product with auto start enabled, a useless task scheduler entry would remain post installation.[/*][*]For the local documentation generation, fixed the super ring map animations.[/*][*]Added video references to the local documentation. The videos are still hosted remotely, but now they can be viewed within the local documentation.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Product Announcement: Virtual Touch Screen 2
notes.content:
I would imagine that many of you have been wanting to use the Virtual Touch Screen but do not have a KinectV2.  Well, after years of work, it is time to announce that my new product, Virtual Touch Screen 2, will be in early access soon.  It will have very low requirements and operate with a simple webcam rather than the KinectV2.  Virtual Touch Screen 2 will be a standalone product, but in the future I may be able to provide full integration with Simplode Suite for maximum synergy.

If you are interested, please follow the Virtual Touch Screen 2 store page.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2588630/Virtual_Touch_Screen_2/?beta=1
I can't give a release date yet, but I can say the wait should not be very long.  I am planning to have a play test soon and will be eager to receive feedback.

notes.content:
2021-02-02 - Released Version 1.1.1.389
[list]
[*]To avoid confusion, the Free Trial segment of the Welcome screen is now hidden if you have unlocked every package.[/*][*]Reduced memory usage of the menu ring by loading each ring on demand.  If the memory management strategy is set to Maximum Performance, the ring will be preloaded as before.[/*][*]Reduced memory usage when the menu ring is closed.  If the memory management strategy is set to Maximum Performance, the ring will remain in memory for faster access.[/*][*]It is now possible to open multiple separate ring menus simultaneously.  It can be accessed in the (...) menu of the flyout for a menu under (🔾*) New Ring Menu, which will launch that menu as a new ring.[/*][*]Fixed an error that could occur when exiting the application.[/*][*]Fixed issue with weather tray icons not being visible if more color icons are turned off.[/*][*]Fixed issue when attempting to open Simplode Suite when Simplode Suite is already open. The cancel button now properly closes the new launch attempt.[/*][*]Slightly optimized glow effects by removing unused code.[/*][*]Fixed issue where reloading icons could cause the tool to go become temporarily unresponsive and use excessive amounts of memory.[/*][*]Changing the glow icon intensity setting or glow icon effect enabled setting will now reload all icons.[/*][*]Added the Caps Lock Overload feature.  If enabled, the caps lock key is overloaded.  Holding the caps lock key will activate both the Windows key and the control key. notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.320 Released
notes.content:
2021-1-2 - Released Version 1.1.1.320
[list][*]Mouse display no longer shows in taskbar.[/*][*]Added task bar tasks.  When right clicking on the Simplode Suite task bar entry, you can now easily access the Ring Menu Settings, the Ring in Taskbar option, the Main Menu, and the Action Search.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the Toggle Ring Menu hotkey management not working in certain situations.[/*][*]Fixed an exception in the Hidden Actions feature.[/*][*]Fixed a rare exception during application startup.[/*][*]Fixed an issue with the translation engine attempting to translate already translated text.[/*][*]Fixed some missing translations throughout the application.[/*][*]Added a basic hotkey manager to see all of the tool's hotkeys in one screen.[/*][*]Removed the default hotkey for Restart Explorer.[/*][*]Removed the default hotkey for Sleep.[/*][*]Changed the default hotkey for Toggle Ring Menu to [Win]+[Shift]+[Tab] to avoid conflicts with web browsers.[/*][*]Added more options to the Screen Off feature: 
  Blackout Mode: The screen off feature will keep turning the screen off until you hit a key or click with the mouse.  Additionally, it will black out the entire screen.   This helps in case your mouse erroneously wakes up the screens.

This is less secure than immediately activating the lock screen, but the lock screen is more of a casual deterrence measure anyways if an adversary has physical access to your machine.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.36 Released
notes.content:
11/13/2020 - Released Version 1.1.1.36
The Freaky Friday update is here to make Simplode Suite less freaky.  The changes fix issues with beta features and improve the functionality and usability of strict preset found in the welcome screen to offer the option of a higher level of predictability while still maintaining easy access to the application's features.[list][*]Free Beta Features have been disabled by default.  This is how the Free Beta Features were intended to work, so I am unsure as to why they were enabled by default in the first place.[/*][*]Fixed issue where Steam users who had registered the Free Beta Features DLC on their account would always have Free Beta Features enabled, even if the the Free Beta Features were not set to be enabled within the application.[/*][*]Added a warning confirmation prompt to the Red Cyan Desktop 3D beta feature.  The feature is reported to have compatibility issues on some systems.  Before trying this feature for the first time, please ensure you have saved all of your work and are prepared to restart your computer if necessary.[/*][*]Added the Ring Menu Quick Toggle Settings option, which is available in the Toggle Ring Menu flyout and is enabled by default.
If enabled, clicking on a settings toggling action button in a ring menu will instantly toggle the setting.  If disabled, it will open the flyout window where you can click again to toggle the setting.
This setting is disabled in strict mode, making it less likely to accidentally turn on an unwanted setting.[/*][*]Added the Ring Menu Quick Activate Actions option, which is available in the Toggle Ring Menu flyout and is enabled by default.
If enabled, clicking on an action activating button in a ring menu will instantly activate the action.  If disabled, it will open the flyout window where you can click again to activate the action.
This setting is disabled in strict mode, making it less likely to accidentally activate an unwanted action.[/*][*]Strict mode now disables Window Hover Linking.  Previously Window Hover Linking would still not function in strict mode because it requires External Input be enabled to function, which Strict mode also disables.[/*][*]If External Input is disabled, attempts to enable features which require External Input will now ask if you would like to also enable External Input.  This change has been made for the following features: Changing Hotkeys, Window Hover Linking, Mouse Accelerator, Mouse Wheel Accelerator, Cursor Finder, Mouse Display, Keyboard Dynamic Repeat, Keyboard Hold Next Key, Keyboard Toggle Next Toggle Key, and Focus Free Interactions.[/*][*]Fixed bug where action hotkeys would not immediately work after turning on External Input.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.1.1 Released
notes.content:
2020-11-4 Simplode Suite 1.1.1.1 Released!

After receiving many requests to make Simplode Suite available in other languages, especially from Chinese users who have been very supportive, I have added internationalization support.  I did not originally write the code with internationalization in mind, but I have implemented a custom solution which seems to work.  I am not fluent in any language besides English, so I will be relying heavily on users to report any issues.
I have added automatically generated translations for the following languages:[list][*]Arabic (العربية) - Arabic may face a lot of issues regarding right to left text support.
[*]Bulgarian (Български)
[*]Chinese (Simplified) (简体中文)
[*]Chinese (Traditional) (繁體中文)
[*]Czech (Čeština)
[*]Danish (Dansk)
[*]Dutch (Nederlands)
[*]Finnish (Suomi)
[*]French (Français)
[*]German (Deutsch)
[*]Greek (Ελληνικά)
[*]Hungarian (Magyar)
[*]Italian (Italiano)
[*]Japanese (日本語)
[*]Korean (한국어)
[*]Norwegian (Norsk)
[*]Polish (Polski)
[*]Portuguese (Português)
[*]Romanian (Română)
[*]Russian (Русский)
[*]Spanish (Español)
[*]Swedish (Svenska)
[*]Thai (ไทย)
[*]Turkish (Türkçe)
[*]Ukrainian (Українська)
[*]Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt)
[/list]The translation files automatically download when selected in the Welcome Menu.
I am prepared to add more automatically translated languages in the future, but for now I want to see if there is any important feedback that may impact my automatic translation process before proceeding.
If anyone would like to offer improvements to the translation files, I will gratefully accept.  The files are downloaded to "%localappdata%\Simplode Suite\translations" and probably need little explanation, as they are simple JSON formatted mappings from English to other languages, though they do include replacement variables in many cases in the format of {0}, {1}, {2}, etc.

I have also included other small feature improvements and bug fixes:[list][*]The Toggle Ring Menu to Favorites option now works when the application first starts, and has been modified to open the favorites menu when left clicking on the Simplode button.
[*]Folders that are mirrored in the favorites menu will now ignore hidden files and folders.
[*]Reintroduced flyout locking.  By default, flyout windows that have not been clicked will close automatically when clicking another window.Detailed options are available in the flyout, which you can use to determine if and when to prevent flyouts from automatically closing, which can be used to get the old behavior of leaving flyout windows open always.
[*]Added VSync option to the Red Cyan 3D feature.
[*]Added VSync option to the Equalizer Ring feature.
[*]Fixed bug with some windows not having a action button available.This had caused exceptions in some cases.
[*]Fixed an exception that would occur sometimes when closing a window too quickly after being opened.
[*]Adjusted readonly text boxes to have normal appearance.
[/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite 1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
9/1/2020 - Released version 1.1.0.0
This is a large update to Simplode Suite.  This release includes improvements and bug fixes across the board.[list][*]The free functionality of the application has been massively expanded.  In this version, every single feature is either simply available for free, or can be selected as your one free feature.  This way, all who discover the product in search of some specific functionality will be able to get that functionality instantly and for free.  My hope is that users will convert to customers when they discover they like the product and want more.  The free select feature can be changed as many times as you like, but once you make a selection, you must wait 24 hours to change it.[/*][*]Added the free feature of the day.  In conjuction with the free select feature, the free feature of the day gives the user as many chances as they need to try out other parts of the software in a daily rotation.[/*][*]The free trial system has been overhauled.  Registration is no longer required.  Upon installation, you automatically receive a free trial of all features for 24 hours.  Additionally, you can enable the free trial up to 3 more times, each for 24 hours.  [/*][*]Steam integration has been prepared, but must remain disabled until the actual Steam release occurs.  The website download version will support the same Steam integrated features as the Steam installed version.  The application will need an update after the Steam release to unlock the Steam integration.[/*][*]Added Achievements feature.  This feature will be compatible with Steam Achievements, but can also work without Steam, with options to prevent sending statistics to Steam.[/*][*]When right clicking on the background of a menu ring, the flyout window for the menu will now appear.[/*][*]Fixed crash when audio device is not detected.  User is now notified about the failure and the program continues to function.[/*][*]Made adjustments to DPI settings detection.[/*][*]Adjusted per monitor DPI handling.[/*][*]Added DPI scaling to window tabs.[/*][*]Mitigated issue with per monitor DPI scaling by waiting for windows to finish moving before changing scale.[/*][*]Fixed scaling issue with hover window linking interface.[/*][*]Enabled per monitor DPI scaling by default.[/*][*]Adjusted glow effects to adjust for scaling.[/*][*]Added Glow Content Maximum Fidelity style setting, which can be used to limit resource usage on glow effects, which can become increasingly taxing at high scaling ratios.[/*][*]Adjusted element visual caching to adjust for scaling.[/*][*]Added Cache Maximum Fidelity, which can be used to limit resource usage on element caching, which can become increasingly taxing at high scaling ratios.[/*][*]Greatly improved use of caching in the ring menu system, yielding substantial performance improvement, especially in super ring mode.[/*][*]Made massive improvements in usability for the Favorites Menu in the Super Ring.  Rearranging items is easier with better animation management.  Newly added rings work immediately without the need to reopen the super ring.[/*][*]Fixed bug where the Main Menu floating button would sometimes activate the wrong action when clicked after making favorites menu adjustments.[/*][*]Added action button tool tips.  The tool tips can be adjusted or disabled in the Toggle Ring Menu action details.[/*][*]Automatic Flyouts are now disabled by default, and can be adjusted or enabled in the Toggle Ring Menu action details.[/*][*]Fixed issue where Window Menu actions inside a Task flyout would not target the Task's window in some cases.[/*][*]Window tabs now update their tab text to match changed window titles.[/*][*]Fixed bug where the Move Window action offsets from the cursor in some multiple monitor situations.[/*][*]Fixed issue that could sometimes freeze the tool's window management functionality when creating tab groups.[/*][*]Fixed a minor graphical issue with ring menu animations.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where double clicks on action buttons were being incorrectly detected.  This issue was causing the super ring feature to be wrongly triggered in some cases.[/*][*]Adjusted ordering of actions throughout the tool to alphabetical by default.  To keep related actions together, some action names have had minor adjustments, and some actions have been manually adjusted to appear in a prioritized order.[/*][*]Added Orb Button Background color control to the Customize Style feature.[/*][*]Improved performance of flyout window creation, especially when animation is disabled.[/*][*]Fixed minor graphical issues associated with flyout animation style settings.[/*][*]Fixed issue where icons would not be rendered if glow is disabled.[/*][*]Added Bare Minimum performance preset option to welcome screen.[/*][*]Fixed flicker that would occur when opening the ring menu with animation disabled.[/*][*]Reduced/removed flicker when using Screenshot Box.[/*][*]Added ability to include the cursor in screenshots taken using the tool.[/*][*]Fixed issue where mouse movements are sometimes unable to return full screen magnification to normal by moving the mouse outside of the zoomed area.[/*][*]Adjusted cursor movement demagnification to avoid off screen magnification.[/*][*]Disabled Magnify With Bump Roll setting in Strict Mode.[/*][*]Magnify App now has the capability to frame the magnified area to the current screen, which will now be enabled by default.[/*][*]Added Magnify Area option, to magnify a select area of the screen.[/*][*]Fixed bug that prevented settings from being saved and loaded correctly in some cases.[/*][*]Fixed bug that sometimes prevented relocation of favorites menu items.[/*][*]Fixed bug that prevented drag and drop from a browser's URL bar to the favorites menu.[/*][*]Fixed bug that caused the Favorites Menu Add URL feature to incorrectly include an additional "http://" prefix when the user already included a prefix.[/*][*]Fixed bug that caused mouse button combos to double activate in some cases.[/*][*]Massively improved performance of Microphone Manager UI.[/*][*]Fixed Microphone Manager issue where Volume Setting Maximum would not be enforced properly.[/*][*]Fixed issue where Microphone Manager settings would be incomplete or wrong when using the priority coprocess.[/*][*]Added application specific volume control actions.[/*][*]Added new Audio Focus feature, which can separately adjust volume of focused and unfocused applications automatically.[/*][*]Added wake reason and wake timers information to Super Sleep and Super Hibernate settings panels.[/*][*]Fixed issue where Chill Boost would not work correctly when on battery power.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Chill Boost would get stuck at maximum speed on some devices.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where Chill Boost would get stuck at minimum speed on some devices.[/*][*]Added stats to Chill Boost, which are used in conjuction with achievements.[/*][*]Fixed issue where sometimes settings changes were not saved if changed just before exiting the tool.[/*][*]Fixed pacing issue with Keyboard Dynamic Repeat.[/*][*]Changed behavior of the Repeat Next Key action to repeat the next key that is pressed twice, using the difference to set the repetition rate.[/*][*]Changed behavior of the Toggle Next Toggle Key action to watch for the next key that is held down, rather than the next key that is pressed.[/*][*]Added option for Keyboard Dynamic Repeat to ignore modifier keys.[/*][*]Added option for directly typing a new GUID when using the New Guid To Clipboard feature.  Using this option will help guard the user from accidentally using the same GUID twice.[/*][*]Improved Fake Focus feature to work more reliably and added some documentation notes to indicate situations where it does not yet work.[/*][*]Fixed issue with Mouse Accelerator not working properly when Adaptive Mode is disabled.[/*][*]Added Chill Boost Efficiency Locker Target Power State setting.[/*][*]Added notification when Chill Boost Auto Calibration completes which shows the changes that have been applied.[/*][*]Improved Efficiency Locker Dropped Frame Resistance.[/*][*]Fixed Chill Boost to handle operating system profile switching.  If multiple sessions are running Chill Boost, the most recently unlocked session will take control.  If the most recently unlocked session is not running Chill Boost, the previous session's Chill Boost will retain control, but Chill Boost can be disabled by changing the power scheme in this case.[/*][*]Fixed documentation pop up positioning issue.[/*][*]Added style config for orb button backgrounds.[/*][*]Changed default color of orb button backgrounds to be more transparent.[/*][*]Added Stand feature, which periodically shows full screen semi-transparent reminders to do things like stand up for health reasons, or anything else you need to remind yourself.  The messages can optionally be delivered at opportune times by watching mice, keyboards, and gamepads for a time where you are not busy.  This feature will be included for free because of its potential health benefits.[/*][*]Added Smart Focus feature to move newly focused windows to the location of your cursor or open your start menu to whichever monitor your cursor is on when hitting the operating system key.[/*][*]Added Twitch to the default Glass Apps video title indicator list.[/*][*]Fixed a window positioning bug that impacted minimized windows.[/*][*]Fixed a window positioning bug when maximizing a window group.[/*][*]Fixed a window focusing bug when moving a window in a tab group.[/*][*]When using a grouping hotkey while a window is being moved, the window grouping system becomes glitched.  Added a check to prevent window grouping while a window is still being moved.[/*][*]Adjusted ungroup functionality to fill out empty space in new group layout, both in group window mode and group maximize mode.[/*][*]Fixed bug where in some circumstances, virtually maximized groups would forget how to go back to their original shape when restored.[/*][*]Adjusted the secondary behavior of Task Menu tasks and Favorites Menu tasks to also move any grouped windows while moving the target window.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where some programs would become glitchy when using Mouse Button Chord Resize.[/*][*]Changed Mouse Button Chord Resize to base its expansion direction on where the cursor starts with respect to the window.[/*][*]Fixed multiple issues where the input grabber could get stuck and prevent mouse clicks.[/*][*]Fixed issue where windows sometimes needed to be activated once before Simplode Suite could interact with them.[/*][*]Made it more difficult to accidentally trigger mouse wheel zooming.[/*][*]Fixed bug where screenshot preview window did not take focus until it was clicked.  The bug was allowing games which take control of the mouse to prevent the screenshot preview window from working correctly.[/*][*]Fixed bug in Microphone Manager where devices that report unusable volume ranges can prevent the entire microphone manager from working.[/*][*]Increased the size of numeric fields throughout the application.[/*][*]Improved the communication mechanism between Simplode Suite processes.  Before, all communication was handled by WCF services over named pipes, where each coprocess needed its own stateful connection to the main process.  Most of this communication has been replaced by a custom multicast implementation over shared memory.  The primary reason for this change is that the WCF implementation made finding and fixing communication issues very complicated.  However, the custom solution also created an opportunity to improve performance and efficiency.[/*][*]Set a minimum size for cropped screenshots to avoid accidental tiny dot sized screenshot windows.[/*][*]Added the ability for cropped screenshots to include the cursor.[/*][*]Auto start with admin rights now works on a per user basis.[/*][*]Fixed bug where settings can get mixed up between operating system profiles if one user leaves the tool running when switching to another user who also runs the tool.[/*][*]Made some improvements on how Simplode Suite windows layer themselves in front of and behind eachother and other windows.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Simplode Suite Version 1.0.0.5655
notes.content:
Released version 1.0.0.5655 (Originally Released 2/10/2020)
-Improved icon detection for favorites menu.  Now it can grab icons for Steam shortcuts.
-Allow dragging multiple items into favorites menu from explorer.

(Not yet available through Steam)

notes.title: Simplode Suite Version 1.0.0.5623
notes.content:
Released version 1.0.0.5623 (Originally Released 2/3/2020)
-Included Tiling Window Manager action, which is just a more cohesive way to expose the existing window grouping functions.
-Added a new way to exit the tool.  If the task bar icon is enabled, right clicking and closing will hide the ring menu.  If the ring menu is already hidden, right clicking and closing will ask if you want to completely exit the tool, where you can answer yes to completely exit the tool.

(Not yet available through Steam)
